dedupe_keys.name: input torque measurements for wind turbine gearboxes using fiber optical strain sensors

description: TU Delft publishes torque-calibration and dynamic-test data for wind-turbine gearboxes instrumented with fifty-four fibre-optic strain sensors. The collection contains twenty calibration steps from five to one hundred percent torque, one nominal-torque dataset and two dynamic torque tests. These native releases are retained as related parts of one torque-estimation research dataset. Coverage: Individual native time-coverage fields and dates apply separately; no common interval is imposed. Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: MATLAB data files. Licence: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: Animation-only item 113 remains a presentation artefact. Measurement files and torque-estimation performance were not independently tested. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
